variables.name: commodities
variables.description: Every commodity line with its class, dimensions, cube, density, and hazmat flag. Use with map, filter, and sum: sum(map(commodities, .cubicFeet ?? 0)), any(commodities, .freightClass == "85")

variables.name: commodities[].cubicFeet
variables.description: Length × width × height × pieces; empty when any dimension is missing

variables.name: commodities[].density
variables.description: Pounds per cubic foot, weight ÷ cubicFeet; empty without a cube

variables.name: commodities[].freightClass
variables.description: NMFC freight class of the commodity, such as 55 or 85

variables.name: commodities[].hazmat
variables.description: Whether the commodity is a hazardous material

variables.name: commodities[].heightFeet
variables.description: Height per piece in feet; empty when not recorded

variables.name: commodities[].lengthFeet
variables.description: Length per piece in feet; empty when not recorded

variables.name: commodities[].name
variables.description: Commodity name; empty when the line has no commodity record

variables.name: commodities[].pieces
variables.description: Pieces on this line

variables.name: commodities[].stackable
variables.description: Whether the commodity can be stacked

variables.name: commodities[].weight
variables.description: Weight of this line

variables.name: commodities[].widthFeet
variables.description: Width per piece in feet; empty when not recorded

variables.name: currentTotalCharge
variables.description: The total charge stored on the shipment before this rating ran: 0 on a new shipment, and the previous save's total afterwards. A freight charge formula that reads it prices against its own last result

variables.name: deliveryDate
variables.description: The delivery as a date in the delivery location's local time (UTC when the location has no timezone), from the final delivery stop's actual departure, actual arrival, scheduled window end, or scheduled window start; empty when the shipment has no delivery stop

variables.name: density
variables.description: Total weight over total cubic feet in pounds per cubic foot; empty when no commodity line has dimensions

variables.name: hasHazmat
variables.description: Whether any shipment commodity is hazardous material

variables.name: highestFreightClass
variables.description: Numerically highest freight class on the shipment, which governs a mixed LTL shipment without a mixing exception; empty when no line has a class

variables.name: isWeekendPickup
variables.description: Whether the pickup falls on a Saturday or Sunday in the pickup location's local time, or UTC when the location has no timezone

variables.name: pickupDate
variables.description: The pickup as a date in the pickup location's local time (UTC when the location has no timezone), from the first pickup stop's actual arrival or scheduled window start. Supports date methods such as pickupDate.Hour() and comparisons with date("2026-01-01"); empty when the shipment has no pickup stop

variables.name: pickupDayOfWeek
variables.description: Day of week of the pickup (0 = Sunday through 6 = Saturday) in the pickup location's local time, or UTC when the location has no timezone; from the first stop's actual arrival or scheduled window; 0 when the shipment has no stops

variables.name: pickupHour
variables.description: Hour of the pickup (0-23) in the pickup location's local time, or UTC when the location has no timezone; from the first stop's actual arrival or scheduled window; 0 when the shipment has no stops

variables.name: pickupMonth
variables.description: Month of the pickup (1-12) in the pickup location's local time, or UTC when the location has no timezone; 0 when the shipment has no stops

variables.name: primaryFreightClass
variables.description: Freight class of the heaviest commodity line; empty when no line has a class

variables.name: requiresTemperatureControl
variables.description: Whether the shipment requires temperature control

variables.name: stops
variables.description: Every stop on the shipment in move and sequence order, with its type, status, window, actuals, and location. Use with map, filter, and sum: count(stops, .type == "Delivery"), sum(map(stops, .weight ?? 0))

variables.name: stops[].actualArrival
variables.description: Actual arrival as unix seconds; empty until the driver arrives

variables.name: stops[].actualDeparture
variables.description: Actual departure as unix seconds; empty until the driver departs

variables.name: stops[].city
variables.description: City of the stop's location

variables.name: stops[].pieces
variables.description: Pieces handled at this stop; empty when not recorded

variables.name: stops[].scheduleType
variables.description: Open or Appointment

variables.name: stops[].sequence
variables.description: Zero-based order of the stop within its move

variables.name: stops[].state
variables.description: State abbreviation of the stop's location

variables.name: stops[].status
variables.description: Stop status such as New, InTransit, Completed, or Canceled

variables.name: stops[].timezone
variables.description: IANA timezone of the stop's location; empty when the location has none

variables.name: stops[].type
variables.description: Pickup, Delivery, SplitPickup, or SplitDelivery

variables.name: stops[].weight
variables.description: Weight handled at this stop; empty when not recorded

variables.name: stops[].windowEnd
variables.description: Scheduled window end as unix seconds; empty when not set

variables.name: stops[].windowStart
variables.description: Scheduled window start as unix seconds; empty when not set

variables.name: stops[].zip
variables.description: Postal code of the stop's location

variables.name: temperatureDifferential
variables.description: Difference between maximum and minimum temperature requirements

variables.name: totalCubicFeet
variables.description: Sum of length × width × height × pieces across commodity lines that have all three dimensions; lines without dimensions add nothing

variables.name: totalDistance
variables.description: Total distance across all moves

variables.name: totalHours
variables.description: Hours from the first stop arrival to the last stop departure, using actual times and falling back to the scheduled windows

variables.name: totalLinearFeet
variables.description: Total linear feet from shipment commodities

variables.name: totalPieces
variables.description: Total shipment pieces including commodity fallback

variables.name: totalStops
variables.description: Total number of stops across all moves

variables.name: totalWeight
variables.description: Total shipment weight including commodity fallback

variables.name: fuelIndexCode
variables.description: Code of the fuel index behind fuelPrice, such as DOE_US; empty when no index has a price

variables.name: fuelPrice
variables.description: Latest fuel price per gallon from the organization's freshest active fuel index, supplied at rating time; empty when no index has a price, so guard it with coalesce(fuelPrice, 0) or a fallback lookup

variables.name: fuelPriceDate
variables.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the fuel price behind fuelPrice; empty when no index has a price

variables.name: ratingTime
variables.description: The date the contract terms are read at, as a UTC instant: the date the rating asked for, else the actual ship date, else when the shipment was entered. It is fixed for a shipment, so it stands in for "now" and re-rating gives the same answer. Supports date methods such as ratingTime.Year() and comparisons with date("2026-01-01")

variables.name: customer.code
variables.description: Customer code

variables.name: customer.name
variables.description: Customer company name

variables.name: destination.city
variables.description: City of the final delivery stop's location; empty when the stop has no location

variables.name: destination.state
variables.description: State abbreviation of the final delivery stop's location; empty when unavailable

variables.name: destination.zip
variables.description: Postal code of the final delivery stop's location; empty when unavailable

variables.name: origin.city
variables.description: City of the first pickup stop's location; empty when the stop has no location

variables.name: origin.state
variables.description: State abbreviation of the first pickup stop's location; empty when unavailable

variables.name: origin.zip
variables.description: Postal code of the first pickup stop's location; empty when unavailable

variables.name: serviceType.code
variables.description: Service type code, such as STD or EXP

variables.name: serviceType.description
variables.description: Service type description

variables.name: baseRate
variables.description: Base rate per unit for freight charge calculation

variables.name: freightChargeAmount
variables.description: Calculated freight charge amount in USD

variables.name: otherChargeAmount
variables.description: Total additional charges in USD

variables.name: pieces
variables.description: Number of pieces in the shipment

variables.name: proNumber
variables.description: The PRO number uniquely identifying the shipment

variables.name: ratingUnit
variables.description: Unit value used in rating calculations

variables.name: status
variables.description: Current status of the shipment

variables.name: temperatureMax
variables.description: Maximum required temperature in Fahrenheit

variables.name: temperatureMin
variables.description: Minimum required temperature in Fahrenheit

variables.name: weight
variables.description: Total weight of the shipment in pounds

variables.name: shipmentType.code
variables.description: Shipment type code

variables.name: shipmentType.description
variables.description: Shipment type description

variables.name: tractorType.code
variables.description: Equipment type code

variables.name: tractorType.description
variables.description: Equipment type description

variables.name: trailerType.code
variables.description: Equipment type code

variables.name: trailerType.description
variables.description: Equipment type description
